name: Test Management
description: Lets a granted agent create test cases, trigger test runs and manage test data in an external test-management system (Xray, Zephyr or qTest) without ever handling the vendor API token. A credential-holding broker sidecar keeps the token on the agent's behalf, so it never reaches the agent, and stamps every test artifact it creates with the caller's scope — one team's cases and runs stay invisible to another's. Authorisation is enforced per action and per scope: some commands (for example creating a case) are restricted to a single agent, and destructive operations such as deleting test data are held for a human's confirmation before they run. Agents drive it with the dependency-free `aee-test` command-line tool — for example `aee-test create-case ...` to add a case, or `aee-test trigger --plan REGRESSION --wait` to start a run and wait for the result. Requires network egress to reach the test-management system.

credentials.description: Test-management system API token (held only by the broker)

promptLine: You can create test cases, trigger test runs and manage test data in the team's test-management system with `aee-test` — run `aee-test --help`. The broker holds the vendor credential and enforces per-scope policy: creating test cases is restricted to the final agent in the flow once its cross-checks have passed, and destructive test-data operations wait for a human's confirmation.
